Review my audio plugin release evidence.

interface.longDescription: Turn an audio-plugin idea into a scoped implementation brief, an original mono LV2 gain scaffold, and an evidence-based build handoff. Includes portable Python scripts for fixed-recipe compilation, offline audio checks, exact-byte packaging, and truthful release receipts. Native execution needs an available authorized local runtime and C compiler; ChatGPT web and mobile do not gain access to your computer. No account credentials, automatic signing, publishing, or paid services are required. This first release does not provide JUCE, AU, VST3, AAX, ASIO, or universal DAW compatibility.

publication.release_notes: Adds platform release review for asset staging, per-architecture macOS floors/preflight, separate AAX and Windows publisher signature evidence, and publication-scope checks. Original runtime validated through the installed private skill on macOS arm64; no new DSP or platform support.
